answer: SELECT category,COUNT(*) line_count,SUM(net_revenue_cents)/100.0 revenue_usd,SUM(margin_cents)/100.0 margin_usd,ROUND(100.0*SUM(margin_cents)/NULLIF(SUM(net_revenue_cents),0),2) margin_pct FROM facts GROUP BY category ORDER BY margin_usd DESC;

details.grain: one product line within an order

notice: Synthetic retail case. These queries describe observed order lines, not causal drivers. Returned lines fully reverse revenue/cost; shipping, tax and processing fees are excluded.
